function: Soft actor-critic agent jointly sets BS downlink beamforming and RIS phase shifts, plus source encoder rate control, to maximize average video PSNR (p. 5).
system: Downlink MU-MISO: M-antenna BS, K single-antenna users, passive reflecting RIS with N elements and phase-dependent amplitude; bandwidth 50 kHz, carrier band not stated (pp. 2, 7).
method: Soft actor-critic deep RL: MLP stochastic actor, two Q-network critics, trained by reinforcement learning with replay buffer and PSNR reward; mean action at test (pp. 4-6).
data_channel: Custom simulator: Rayleigh cascaded channels, CN(0,1) initialization, imperfect channel estimate, ten random environments; no standard model or measured data (pp. 2, 7).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated in the same simulated environment per setting (K=M=4, 8, 12; N=8, 12, 16); learning curves averaged over ten random environments; no unseen condition (pp. 6-8).
baselines: Learned only: SAC scheme of [13] (physical-layer DRL), plus enlarged 'baseline scheme complicated'; stochastic-policy variant of proposed scheme; no non-learned baseline (pp. 6-8).
metrics: Average PSNR (dB) learning curves, convergence time steps (7500 vs 20000), total model parameters, testing time in seconds (pp. 6-8).
complexity: Table V: total parameters 19.9M vs 4.2M baseline (4.73 times) and testing time 81.95 s vs 53.29 s at K=M=4, N=12; also K=M=8, 12 (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 2: "cascaded channel following a Rayleigh distribution". Custom Rayleigh simulator (Table III on p. 7 lists Rayleigh initialization); no 3GPP model, QuaDRiGa, DeepMIMO, or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 6: "each experiment is executed using ten different environments". These are random realizations of the same setting, with separate models and hyper-parameters per K, M (Tables I-II); no test in an unseen scenario, band, or antenna or user count.
q3_support: p. 6: "baseline scheme [13] and proposed scheme are depicted". The only learned baseline is the SAC scheme of [13] and its enlarged version (p. 7); no non-learned method (random or fixed RIS, optimization) is compared.
q4_support: p. 7: "our proposed methods increased the complexity by 4.7 times compared to the baseline scheme"; Table V (p. 8) gives total parameters and testing time in seconds.
q5_support: p. 2: "cascaded channel following a Rayleigh distribution". Own simulated data; no code or data link, no public channel dataset, and no availability statement anywhere in pp. 1-9.
notes: Includes: the learned decision is BS beamforming and RIS phase shifts (physical layer) jointly with source encoder rate control (application layer), so it passes above_phy; area 3. Text layer lacks Tables I-V, so they were read as images of pp. 5, 7, 8. The 7500 vs 20000 step comparison is convergence speed only. Fig. 13 varies N with separate training curves, so it is not a new-condition test.
